channel.title: Maritime Security Advisories (SAMPLE FEED - fictional items for testing)

item.title: Merchant vessel struck by one-way attack drone near Bab el-Mandeb
item.description: SAMPLE: A container ship was struck 45 nm NW of Bab el-Mandeb; crew safe, fire contained. Threat level for the southern Red Sea remains SEVERE.

item.title: Tanker seized by armed boarding party in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: SAMPLE: Vessel boarded and diverted to territorial waters. Masters advised to report suspicious approaches.

item.title: Piracy attack reported off Lome, Gulf of Guinea
item.description: SAMPLE: Robbers boarded an anchored product tanker.

item.title: Suspicious approach by skiffs in the Strait of Malacca
item.description: SAMPLE: Two skiffs approached a bulk carrier and withdrew after alarm raised. No boarding.

item.title: Old notice: exercise completed in the English Channel
item.description: SAMPLE: Naval exercise completed without incident.
